workspaceId.description: Worktree id in the worktree registry

attempt.description: Failed attempts so far plus one (see WorkerEndReason); 1 for the first run

previousSessionId.description: The session this one replaces (restart, handoff or retry), like AG-UI parentRunId

baseCommit.description: Commit a new checkout started at: its dependencies' combined work (#134), else its task's pinned target (#219); absent for older tasks, which started at the main branch

baseBranch.description: Local branch a new checkout started from, when it started from one (older tasks; #219 checkouts start from a commit and the target is in task.target)
